hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Run helper.
Let number be the numeric entry list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'rateAiArg' in aiArg.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame and util passes a fraction roll of number, then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to form list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNoTriple'.
  Choose state 12 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then
  Append the register's 'abilityId_1' to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  The enemy uses ability immediately.
  Append ability to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  Let ability2 be a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  The enemy uses ability2 immediately.
  Append ability2 to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot and stop.
Let elapsedBattleTime be the elapsed battle time.
Add elapsedBattleTime to the register's 'totalTimeInTriple'.
If the register's 'totalTimeInTriple' is at least the numeric entry list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'changePhaseTime' in aiArg, then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to form list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo'.
  Choose state 11 next.
  Set the register's 'totalTimeInTriple' to 0 and stop.
Run helper2.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability3 be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  The enemy uses ability3.
  Set the register's 'abilityId_1' to ability3.

script_hooks.logic:
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
Let hpRate be the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction (the HP fraction of the enemy) from phase the register's 'currBpIdx'.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy, then
  Set the register's 'currBpIdx' to hpRate.
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
